crew.overview: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept up in an insane adventure, where she alone can save what's important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.
crew.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once

details.biography: Aaron M. Smith is an American Steadicam owner/operator from Ventura, California. He studied film and television at Biola University and started working at Panavision before starting his freelance career. Aaron co-hosts a podcast about Film and TV pros navigating transitions called Scene Change.
details.name: Aaron M. Smith
